scope: Documentation handoff only. No application execution, GUI/native tool use, builds, source edits or further experiments were performed.

prerequisite.must_pass_before_GUI_input: A supported app-control release operation plus verifiable receipt/status must be available and demonstrated.
prerequisite.cleanup_rule: Release and verify after success, failure, exception or interruption before unrelated analysis. Respect enforced stops; Escape interrupts GUI input without cancelling the overall plan.
prerequisite.until_resolved: Keep GUI cases blocked. Native diagnostics cannot satisfy GUI acceptance.

expected_helper_context.observation_requirement: Observe the actual GUI-created helper child Win32 environment and the application-resolved directory/path; the manager environment is insufficient. Do not infer CRT getenv state solely from GetEnvironmentVariableW.
expected_helper_context.cwd_qualification: H2 configuration fetch succeeded with checkout CWD unchanged. The prior GUI child inherited C:\PROBLEM\R1\C instead. Neither CWD is prescribed for a future GUI child: record its actual explicit/inherited CWD and compare against that trial. No CWD change is currently justified for the configuration fetch.

argument_contract.REA_spawn_convention: For a supported independent REA spawn, supply argument tokens only; REA prepends the executable. Do not include a second executable token. This rule does not rewrite the GUI-generated command line.
limitations: The historical -embed 56699 is a session-specific window handle. Never reuse it for a fresh process; capture the new GUI-generated value.
H1/H2 independent native launches omitted -embed and did not exercise embedding or GUI Run Options integration.
The old GUI parent had an accessibility diagnostic guard, so this observation is instrumented evidence.
A relative command line and null application parameter do not by themselves prove the child resolved executable path/hash. Verify both for the new child.
Keep actual token grouping (-dim 3, -jt MO), project path and DB name from the new invocation. Do not invent or normalize unknown GUI arguments.

H1_H2_proof.H1: In owned PID 32824, absent DEF_CFG_DIR and application-resolved empty path led to source-bound file-access false, configuration valid flag 0 and warning-reference execution (sequences 168-174).
H1_H2_proof.H2: In owned PID 5756, documented child DEF_CFG_DIR was present; the app resolved/opened stock configuration, exchanged required 24-byte headers and received 474 bytes counted without payload capture, then returned configuration valid flag 1 (sequences 185-207). No warning-reference event appeared in 221 retained messages, without truncation.
H1_H2_proof.comparison_qualification: H2 corrected both duplicated argv and child environment. This is not a strict one-variable A/B, but the source-bound failed and corrected fetch conditions are directly observed.
not_proven: Cause of the earlier GUI-launched helper warning
Successful complete Run Options setup or embedded UI
Natural successful helper exit; both diagnostic helpers were stopped at their own 45-second deadline
GUI/controller invocation or acceptance of reconstructed DEF_PRE_64 v0.2.1

next_observation.trigger: After the release gate is resolved, the orchestrator performs Run Options in an independently owned MO session using a fresh short-path project.
next_observation.required_record: Correlate the GUI action timestamp and MO parent PID with the actually created helper child PID/creation time, resolved executable path/hash, raw command line including its live embed handle, explicit/inherited CWD, selected DEF_CFG_DIR, application-resolved config path, file-access result, scoped header exchange, valid flag and warning-reference outcome.
next_observation.critical_distinction: These records must come from the helper created by MO, not another independent REA-spawned helper. If capture attaches after the configuration fetch, mark that decision unobserved rather than inferring it from H2.
next_observation.instrumentation_label: Source-bound probes and any accessibility guard make a run instrumented diagnostic evidence; record them separately from unmodified GUI acceptance.
next_observation.metadata_only: No raw license/network payloads, full environment or configuration contents are required.

cleanup_and_solver_scope.ownership: Record PID, creation time, parent chain and image before cleanup; terminate only verified trial-owned processes. Never operate a user-owned session or broad name-matched process set.
cleanup_and_solver_scope.instrumentation_cleanup: Close owned native observer sessions with supported receipts; debugger detachment is not app-control release.
cleanup_and_solver_scope.GUI_cleanup: Supported control release plus verification remains separately mandatory.
cleanup_and_solver_scope.solver_limits: Only after confirmed GUI/controller route and fresh bounded-input validation: one operation, one solver step, one local worker, 120-second job deadline. No MPI, remeshing or multi-operation loop. Preserve installed controllers/solver binaries.
cleanup_and_solver_scope.deadline_evidence: Use an actual supervisor, capture start/end/deadline/owned cleanup and outcome. A metadata field alone does not enforce 120 seconds.
cleanup_and_solver_scope.coverage_limit: A normal one-step no-remesh solver route may not invoke reconstructed DEF_PRE_64 v0.2.1. Record the observed chain; do not force remeshing to manufacture coverage.

required_backend_gates: Independent original replay and matching outputs within established masks
Correct data reopened from disk in GUI
acceptance.deployment: Keep recorded candidate DEF_PRE_64 v0.2.1 fixed unless an established defect requires a rebuild; preserve adjacent originals, never restore them automatically. Reverify deployed hashes before future attribution.
acceptance.project_paths: Independent projects under C:\PROBLEM; every input/generated full path shorter than 100 characters.

compact_resume_checklist: Release API and verified cleanup capability established before GUI input
Fresh owned MO/project and bounded capture identity recorded
Actual child DEF_CFG_DIR plus app-resolved config path observed
Scoped file/header/flag/warning results retained without payloads
Embedding and full setup outcomes reported separately from H2 fetch proof
Owned process/observer cleanup and GUI release each verified
Only bounded 120-second solver scope; all backend acceptance gates remain required
